descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S03 「在什么都没有的医院病历上问 Ask AI，不编造任何东西（10 个里的 5 个）」 Ask AI on a Hospital chart with nothing in it invents nothing (5 of the 10)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Patient with no notes yet: a clear empty state and no errors.（UAT EFS state 2；TFA-94745 state 2）
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer.（UAT EFS state 6；TFA-94745 state 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Five synthetic Hospital patients with only name, age and diagnosis: no vitals, labs, medications, pre-round, encounter, tasks or note

When Ask one question per patient through ai/assist:askChart with the context buildAskContext builds, exactly as the Ask AI sheet does

Then Each answer says the information is not on the chart and names no value, drug, finding or plan that was never entered (no 'No past medical history documented', no narration of documentation status); an empty answer is a failure

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Written from UAT 3.4. An item passes only when the answer says the information is not on the chart (saysNone where its lab regex fits, otherwise a mustInclude of 'not recorded'-type phrases; an empty answer fails that check) AND names nothing that was never entered: noLabValue, numeric vital guards ('/8' for a blood pressure, 'HR 9', '37.'), and drug, task and finding phrases …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U55；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（blocked）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
